human_approval_point: A human architect approves the schema check before channel tasks enter Wave 2.

tasks.objective: Define and approve the stable shipment-event contract consumed by all notification workers.
non_goals: Do not implement channel rendering or vendor delivery.

tasks.objective: Render an email subject and body from an approved shipment event.
non_goals: Do not edit the router or send a real email.

tasks.objective: Render a length-bounded short message from an approved shipment event.
non_goals: Do not edit the router or call a messaging vendor.

tasks.objective: Expose the saved channel choices needed by notification routing.
tasks.deliverable: A preference lookup with deterministic fallback behavior.
non_goals: Do not redesign customer identity or persistence.

tasks.objective: Record the notification decision and outcome without customer message content.
non_goals: Do not change retention policy or logging infrastructure.

tasks.objective: Connect approved channel, preference, and audit artifacts through the central router.
tasks.deliverable: An integrated router with complete acceptance evidence.
non_goals: Do not alter the event schema or platform gateway configuration.
